_about: The Events page at /dallas/events/ (engine/events_page.py). 'file' is the page's listing, written daily by fetch_happening.py next to the page; 'units' is the map's file the ZIP filter and card outline come from. Its one source, Dallas Park and Recreation's calendars, is used under the non-commercial rule (NONCOMMERCIAL.md). 'words' are the page's own text; the engine names no city or source.

words.title: What’s on in Dallas parks
words.intro: Dallas Park and Recreation’s public events for the next 30 days, from its own calendars: Fair Park, Old City Park, recreation centers, outdoor programs and more. Some take place outside the city, at parks the City runs.
words.listing: A listing, not a guide: the facts and a link to each event’s page, nothing else. The library publishes no feed, so its programs aren’t here.
words.desc: What’s on in Dallas parks today, this weekend and this month: Dallas Park and Recreation’s public events, by ZIP code.
words.card: Today, this weekend, the next 30 days
words.source: Events from Dallas Park and Recreation’s calendars (dallasparks.org).
